rules.sectionReferenceMeaning: Use the accepted Latin Niese registry. XVI–XVII use its explicit anchored physical spans, with XVI split sections grouped only for Boolean scope. XVIII–XIX combine actual Niese milestones with explicitly adopted paragraph/element starts. XX honors its partial XX.26 end target. Unavailable identities create no synthetic records.
rules.textTransformations: Exclude marked labels, notes, headings, trailers and front matter. Three literal XVI [...] notices outside accepted intervals and the inherited XX annotation between its accepted XX.26 end and XX.37 start are excluded reversibly. Retain all other source characters, including untagged Roman chapter letters and add/del/unclear/corr/expan content. Trim physical paragraph-fragment edges and join continuing paragraphs with two newlines.
rules.phraseBoundaries: Exact phrases follow the physical source sequence and cannot jump between displaced fragments. Actual TEI gaps and literal dotted interruptions block adjacency. The explicit excluded notices between XVI.188 and 200 and XX.26 and 37 also block adjacency; skipped registry identities alone do not.
rules.editorialMarkup: Preserve exact add/del/unclear attributes and UTF-16 spans in editorialMarks; corr/expan/s/ref appear in sourceMarkup. Do not silently correct readings, omit marginal source words, or generate display glyphs.
rules.unknownContent: Require the frozen accepted XML and identity-registry hashes, with CRLF/LF equivalence. A changed source, unresolved boundary, overlapping interval, lost running character or unreviewed empty span stops extraction.
rules.sourceProjectionDefinition: Each original narrative paragraph is exactly restored from finished recordId slices plus excluded labels/notes and reversible edge whitespace. Anonymous paragraphs use an explicit xpath: source locator, never an invented XML id.
rules.offsetDefinition: Audit sourceText, flat and recordText coordinates are Python Unicode characters, end exclusive. Published inline marks, textGaps and phraseBreaks use JavaScript UTF-16 offsets.
rules.tokenCountDefinition: Unicode L/N start and L/M/N continuation, with explicit source gaps interrupting token formation. The accepted XVII.41–42 milestone separates eleuati and cum without an intervening source space; this precisely audited section boundary separates search tokens and preserves whole-book phrase adjacency.
rules.readerRoute: /antiquities/?book=18&niese={section}; split XVI sections display their accepted physical portions in witness order.

Latin.note: No independent Latin interval for Antiquities XVIII.216 (Tiberius’s astrology and Galba) survives in the present Bamberg transcription. Latin 215 passes directly to 218. The succession-omen and foreknowledge wording remains at Latin 218 as indirect context; it is not assigned a second interval here. Greek and Whiston English context remain independently available. This representation does not establish absence from the original Latin translation or any scribal, exemplar or physical-loss cause.

excluded.text: I Qualiter cyrenius a caesare destinatur ut syriam iudaeamque censeret redditurus etiam archelai substantiam post quam translata est iudaea ex regio habitu ad praesidalem dispositionem.
III Qualiter copinius ex equestri ordine missus est in iudaeam.
IIII Qualiter iuclas galileus et quidam alter persuaserunt multitudine suas describi substantias paterentur.
V Et qualiter plurimi quoque eorum consilia consecuti sunt, donec iozarus pontifex persuasisset eis oboedire magis romanis ut descriptionem fieri non resisterent.
VI Quae et quante sint heres philosophorum apud iudaeos uel qualibus teneantur legibus
VII Qualiter herodes et philippus et arce ciuitates in honorem caesaris fabricarunt.
VIII Qualiter samariaei ossa mortuorum in templo spasmi iactantes cum festiuitas imineret populum per VII dies reddidere pollutum.
VIIII Qualiter salome soror herodis moriens iamniam et omnem regionem suam et fasahelidam et archelaidam iuliae uxori caesaris dereliquid.

X Qualiter pontius uoluit latenter intro mittere ierosolima statua caesaris cognoscens aut populus seditionem aduersus illum commouit donec illas ab ierosolimis in caesaream transmitteret, et de ihesu christo.
XI Quae iudaeis pro illud tempus rome prouenerint per corruptelam samaritici populi, et qualiter pilatus plurimos interemit.
XII Accusatio samaraeorum aduersus pilatum apud uitellium.
XIII Qualiter uitellius romam eum ad caesarem ira conpulit ut ibi rationem eorum quae eam tigerant redderent.

XIIII Uitellius ascendens ierosolima honoratur a populo, et qualiter ob id concessit eis satram, tollamque a romanis in antonia seruabantur in suae potestatis uis suscipere pugna herodis tetrarche aduersus aretam araborum regem et qualiter superatus extiterit.
XV Qualiter tiberius caesar scripsit uitellius ut artabani pardio persuaderet obsides mittere aduersus aretum uero pugnare.
XVI Qualiter tiberius caesar scripsit morte philippi tetrarchias et qualiter tetrarchia enim, in praesidalem dispensationem redacta sit et de baptista iohanne.
XVI Nauigatio agrippe regis romam ad tiberium et qualiter accusatus a proprio liberto deuictus est.
XVII Qualiter herodes tetrarche ueniens romam accusatus fuerit ab agrippa et in exilium missus uel qualiter tetrarchiam eius, marcus agrippa donauerit.
XVIII Seditio iudaeorum et gentilium in alexandria constitutorum et legatio utrorumque ad gaium.
XVIIII Accusatio iudęorum ab apinione caeterisque cum illo legatis propter quod statuam caesaris non haberet.
XX Qualiter iratur gaius mittit per omnium ducem ad syriam cum huiusmodi mandatis ut congre gati manu pugnaret cum iudaeis si nollente ui suscipere simulacrum.
XXI Pestisque contigit iudaeis in babilonia constitutis per obsineum et annileum fratres.
Bamberg Msc. Class. 78
Incipiunt capitula libri XVIII
EXPLICIUNT CAPITULA LIBRI XVIII
CONTINET HIC LIBER TEMPUS ANNORUM TRIGINTA DUUM
FLAUII IOSEPPI ANTIQUITATIS IUDAEICAE LIBER XVIII EXPLICIT.
